Many would tell you that the Tallstrider is a laughable pet. But it's intelligence and loyalty make it a hard creature to match in many situations. If you are interested in the breed, then perhaps I can introduce you and your pet to a few talents I have learned over the years.

Glad you asked. Darkmoon Faire Prize Tickets are our way of letting you help with the faire, and in return you can turn in your tickets for special prizes!

To get started you'll want to talk to Chronos, Kerri Hicks, Ringling and Yebb Nebblegear to see who you can best help. They always have something that needs doing to improve and expand our attractions.

Then when you have enough tickets, speak with Gelvas Grimegate and he will give you a list of prizes to choose from.
